# BCGov Crow - v0.18.0

## Release type

Minor (maintainer-selected classification for the testing and migration workflow updates).

## Summary

Clarifies Crow's testing workflow and moves xUnit v2-to-v3 migration guidance into Crow Legacy Modernization, with .NET 10 as the baseline for new .NET test projects.

## Highlights

- Crow Testing supports xUnit.v3 and directs users with xUnit v2 projects to the separately installed Crow Legacy Modernization Agent.
- Crow Legacy Modernization can assess and perform an explicitly approved xUnit v2-to-v3 migration without starting an application replacement.
- Example Mapping and business-readable test matrices help users agree on expected behavior before implementing tests.
- Adds optional scenario detail for complex cases while keeping the main test matrix business-readable.

## Changes

- Removes xUnit v2 authoring and skip fallbacks from Crow Testing while retaining the migration playbook under Crow Legacy Modernization.
- Requires migration approval, reports blockers, and returns users to Crow Testing after successful migration.
- Updates .NET examples and new-project recommendations to .NET 10 while distinguishing that baseline from xUnit.v3's technical minimum.
- Clarifies greenfield, characterization, and bug-regression testing, predict-then-verify checks, and safe developer hand-offs for unimplemented behavior.
- Adds readiness signals for resolving open questions or splitting oversized stories and rules before implementation.
- Defines how unimplemented behavior is represented by skipped tests on a feature branch until implementation is confirmed.
- Clarifies rule sources: stories, acceptance criteria, and stakeholders for greenfield work, with additional code, documentation, and existing tests for brownfield work.
- Keeps fixes and feature implementation out of the Testing Agent, allows a minimal behavior-preserving test seam only with explicit per-change authorization, and clarifies developer or explicitly authorized implementation hand-offs.
- Distinguishes exploratory characterization, which pins observed behavior, from predict-then-verify for specification and regression tests.
- Defines completion-report status for deliberate red tests, unfixed bug regressions, and unmerged tests when skipping is unavailable.
- Scopes xUnit-specific cancellation and skip guidance to xUnit.v3 suites.
- Keeps collection installation versions aligned with the combined Crow package.

## Installation

Install the tagged release globally:

```powershell
apm install bcgov/crow#v0.18.0 --global --target copilot
```

Or install the packaged archive:

```powershell
apm install .\build\bcgov-crow-0.18.0.zip --global --target copilot
```
